	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"

	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/http/practiceruntime"
	studentnats "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	publicapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	publichandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	privateapi "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	studentconsumer "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/message/nats"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/hybridapplication"
	outboxuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/outbox"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

type t205Fixture struct {
	StudentID          string                     `json:"student_id"`
	PathID             string                     `json:"path_id"`
	Targets            []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"targets"`
	Scope              domain.HybridScopeIdentity `json:"scope"`
	ActiveItemID       string                     `json:"active_item_id"`
	PendingItemID      string                     `json:"pending_item_id"`
	TemplateItemID     string                     `json:"template_item_id"`
	CompletedItemID    string                     `json:"completed_item_id,omitempty"`
	TaskInstanceID     string                     `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string                     `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string                     `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	LearningActionID   string                     `json:"learning_action_id"`
	RequirementID      string                     `json:"requirement_id"`
	PathRevision       int64                      `json:"path_revision"`
}
type t205OwnerClock struct{}

func (t205OwnerClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }
func (t205OwnerClock) NewID() string  { return uuid.NewString() }

// Root alone starts this finite provider. Named initial authored metadata enters
// real owner repositories; completed history enters the real theory-fact UC.
// Official evidence, snapshot, intent, application and NBA use registered routes.
// The Runtime execution projection is explicitly an upstream HTTP fixture.
func TestT205HybridOwnerProvider(t *testing.T) {
	ready, stop, token := os.Getenv("T205_OWNER_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T205_OWNER_STOP_FILE"), os.Getenv("T205_OWNER_TOKEN")
	if ready == "" {
		t.Skip("root-only T205 owner provider gate absent")
	}
	if stop == "" || token == "" || ready == stop || os.Getenv("T205_NATS_URL") != "nats://127.0.0.1:59000" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact isolated provider controls required")
	}
	for _, p := range []string{ready, stop} {
		if _, e := os.Lstat(p); !os.IsNotExist(e) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: fresh control paths required")
		}
	}
	cfg, e := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("STUDENT_T20_DATABASE_URL"))
	if e != nil || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58999 || cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t20_student_integration_proof" || cfg.ConnConfig.User != "postgres" || cfg.ConnConfig.TLSConfig != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact root-owned isolated PostgreSQL required")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, e := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	journey := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	clock := t205OwnerClock{}
	fixtures := map[string]t205Fixture{}
	owned := map[string]t205Fixture{}
	for _, name := range []string{"no_change", "positive", "stale", "active_practice", "intent", "outage"} {
		f := t205InitialOwnerFixture(t, ctx, pool, name)
		fixtures[name] = f
		owned[f.StudentID] = f
	}
	// Ordinary Course activation is fixture setup, before any scenario baseline.
	course := t205OpenCourseFixture(t, ctx, pool, fixtures["no_change"])
	initialA := fixtures["no_change"]
	activeA, e := journey.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, initialA.StudentID, initialA.PathID)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	initialA.PathRevision = activeA.Version
	fixtures["no_change"] = initialA
	owned[initialA.StudentID] = initialA
	practiceToken, teacherToken, controlToken := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	runtimeToken := uuid.NewString()
	runtimeServer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.Method != http.MethodGet || r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != runtimeToken {
			w.WriteHeader(401)
			return
		}
		sid := r.URL.Query().Get("student_id")
		f, ok := owned[sid]
		if !ok || f.LearningActionID == "" || r.URL.Path != "/internal/v2/task-instances/"+f.TaskInstanceID+"/execution-projection" {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		projection := domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{Schema: "practice-execution-projection.v1", StudentID: sid, TaskInstanceID: f.TaskInstanceID, LearningActionID: f.LearningActionID, TaskRevisionID: f.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: f.TaskRevisionDigest, LearningPathID: f.PathID, LearningPathItemID: f.ActiveItemID, RequirementID: f.RequirementID, Status: "READY", SuggestedAction: "RESUME_PRACTICE", AvailableActions: []string{"RESUME_PRACTICE"}, ReasonCode: "named_t205_upstream_open_execution_fixture", Version: "named-t205-runtime-projection-v1"}
		t205JSON(w, projection)
	}))
	defer runtimeServer.Close()
	actions := postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	service := hybridapplication.Service{Applications: journey, Clock: clock}
	getter := studentuc.GetPlanningSnapshot{Reader: journey}
	nba := studentuc.NextActionResolver{Reader: journey, Runtime: practiceruntime.Client{BaseURL: runtimeServer.URL, InternalToken: runtimeToken}}
	h := &privatehandlers.Handler{PlanningSnapshot: getter, HybridApplication: service, NextAction: nba, PracticeEvidence: studentuc.ApplyPracticeEvidence{Evidence: &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}}, PracticeLearningActions: studentuc.PracticeLearningActions{Actions: actions, Clock: clock, IDs: clock}, PracticeLearningEvidence: studentuc.ApplyPracticeLearningActionEvidence{Actions: actions, Clock: clock}}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Mount("/internal", privateapi.NewRouter(h, practiceToken, token, teacherToken, practiceToken))
	public := chi.NewRouter()
	public.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware{}.Middleware)
	publicapi.RegisterHybridIntentRoutes(public, &publichandlers.StudentHybridIntentHandler{Intents: service})
	public.Get("/student/next-action", (&publichandlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler{NextAction: nba}).GetNextAction)
	router.Mount("/api/v1", public)
	nc, e := natsgo.Connect(os.Getenv("T205_NATS_URL"), natsgo.Timeout(3*time.Second))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer nc.Close()
	teacherIngress := studentuc.ApplyTeacherAssistance{Evidence: &postgres.LearningEvidenceRepoPG{Pool: pool}}
	subscriber := studentconsumer.TeacherAssistanceSubscriber{Conn: nc, Handler: func(c context.Context, a domain.TeacherAssistance) (bool, error) {
		if a.StudentID != fixtures["no_change"].StudentID {
			return false, domain.ErrEvidenceContract
		}
		return teacherIngress.Handle(c, a)
	}, AckWait: time.Second, RetryDelay: 100 * time.Millisecond}
	if e := subscriber.Subscribe(ctx); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: real Teacher subscriber needs root TEACHER_EVENTS stream: %v", e)
	}
	relay := outboxuc.Relay{Outbox: postgres.OutboxRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Publisher: &studentnats.OutboxPublisher{Conn: nc}, Clock: clock, WorkerID: "t205-owned-" + uuid.NewString(), BatchSize: 32, LockTTL: time.Minute, PublishTimeout: time.Second, RetryBaseDelay: time.Millisecond, RetryMaxDelay: time.Second}
	var mu sync.Mutex
	faults := map[string]map[string]bool{}
	var relayMu sync.Mutex
	control := func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
		if r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != controlToken {
			w.WriteHeader(401)
			return false
		}
		return true
	}
	var failedMu sync.Mutex
	var failedResult map[string]any
	router.Post("/__t205/failed-course-fact", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !control(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var in struct {
			StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
		}
		if !t205Decode(w, r, &in) {
			return
		}
		f := fixtures["no_change"]
		if in.StudentID != f.StudentID {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		failedMu.Lock()
		defer failedMu.Unlock()
		if failedResult != nil {
			t205JSON(w, failedResult)
			return
		}
		answer, action := course.Answer, course.Action
		closedAt := clock.Now()
		answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed
		answer.EndedAt = &closedAt
		answer.UpdatedAt = closedAt
		// Closure envelope is built from the open-cycle identity; official outcome
		// is persisted separately by CloseAnswer under its exact status guard.
		closure, e := domain.NewLearningActionClosedEvent(uuid.NewString(), action, closedAt)
		if e != nil {
			http.Error(w, e.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		action.Outcome = domain.LearningActionFailed
		action.OutcomePolicyVersion = domain.MasteryPolicyVersion
		if e = actions.CloseAnswer(r.Context(), answer, action, closure); e != nil {
			http.Error(w, e.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		data, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"learning_action_id": action.ID, "context_type": action.ContextType, "context_id": action.ContextID, "support_context": domain.TeacherSupportIndependent, "hints_used": 0, "max_hint_level": nil, "intervention_used": false, "observations": []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{{Target: action.LearningTargets[0], Kind: domain.TeacherObservationIndependentContext}}, "policy_version": "teacher-assistance-v1"})
		upstream := domain.EventEnvelope{EventID: uuid.NewString(), EventType: domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved, CorrelationID: action.ID, CausationID: closure.EventID, StudentID: f.StudentID, OccurredAt: closedAt, SchemaVersion: domain.TeacherAssistanceObservedSchemaVersion, Data: data}
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(upstream)
		if _, e := studentconsumer.DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(raw); e != nil {
			http.Error(w, e.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		js, e := nc.JetStream()
		if e != nil {
			http.Error(w, e.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		msg := natsgo.NewMsg(domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved)
		msg.Data = raw
		msg.Header.Set(natsgo.MsgIdHdr, upstream.EventID)
		if _, e = js.PublishMsg(msg, natsgo.Context(r.Context())); e != nil {
			http.Error(w, e.Error(), 503)
			return
		}
		waitCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 20*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		ticker := time.NewTicker(50 * time.Millisecond)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			var evidence, events int
			e = pool.QueryRow(waitCtx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_action_target_evidence WHERE learning_action_id=$1 AND outcome='failed' AND evidence_kind='failed_application'),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$2 AND subject=$3 AND causation_id=$1::text)`, action.ID, f.StudentID, domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged).Scan(&evidence, &events)
			if e == nil && evidence == 1 && events == 1 {
				failedResult = map[string]any{"learning_action_id": action.ID, "closure_event_id": closure.EventID, "teacher_event_id": upstream.EventID, "classification": "named upstream Course failed execution and Teacher context; actual lifecycle and actual registered NATS subscriber/reducer"}
				t205JSON(w, failedResult)
				return
			}
			select {
			case <-waitCtx.Done():
				http.Error(w, "actual Teacher subscriber commit not observed", 504)
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
			}
		}
	})
	router.Post("/__t205/control", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !control(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var in struct {
			StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
			Fault     string `json:"fault"`
			Enabled   bool   `json:"enabled"`
		}
		if !t205Decode(w, r, &in) {
			return
		}
		if _, ok := owned[in.StudentID]; !ok {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		switch in.Fault {
		case "APPLY_UNAVAILABLE", "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE", "LOSE_NEXT_APPLY_RESPONSE":
		default:
			w.WriteHeader(400)
			return
		}
		mu.Lock()
		if faults[in.StudentID] == nil {
			faults[in.StudentID] = map[string]bool{}
		}
		faults[in.StudentID][in.Fault] = in.Enabled
		mu.Unlock()
		t205JSON(w, map[string]any{"accepted": true})
	})
	router.Post("/__t205/relay", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !control(w, r) {
			return
		}
		var in struct {
			StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
		}
		if !t205Decode(w, r, &in) {
			return
		}
		if _, ok := owned[in.StudentID]; !ok {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		relayMu.Lock()
		defer relayMu.Unlock()
		ids := []string{}
		for sid := range owned {
			ids = append(ids, sid)
		}
		// Park only delivery metadata for these six owned fixtures. Unrelated due
		// rows are refused, so the real global Claim cannot publish foreign facts.
		if _, e := pool.Exec(r.Context(), `UPDATE student_outbox SET next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN student_id=$1 AND subject=$2 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE clock_timestamp()+interval '1 day' END WHERE student_id=ANY($3::uuid[]) AND published_at IS NULL`, in.StudentID, domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged, ids); e != nil {
			http.Error(w, e.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		var foreign int
		if e := pool.QueryRow(r.Context(), `SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE published_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until<=clock_timestamp()) AND NOT(student_id=ANY($1::uuid[]))`, ids).Scan(&foreign); e != nil || foreign != 0 {
			http.Error(w, "unowned due delivery must be parked by root", 409)
			return
		}
		count, e := relay.ProcessBatch(r.Context())
		if e != nil {
			http.Error(w, e.Error(), 503)
			return
		}
		t205JSON(w, map[string]any{"claimed": count})
	})
	router.Get("/__t205/events", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !control(w, r) {
			return
		}
		sid := r.URL.Query().Get("student_id")
		if _, ok := owned[sid]; !ok {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		rows, e := pool.Query(r.Context(), `SELECT payload FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$1 AND subject=$2 ORDER BY occurred_at,event_id`, sid, domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged)
		if e != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(500)
			return
		}
		defer rows.Close()
		events := []json.RawMessage{}
		for rows.Next() {
			var raw []byte
			if rows.Scan(&raw) != nil {
				w.WriteHeader(500)
				return
			}
			events = append(events, json.RawMessage(raw))
		}
		if rows.Err() != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(500)
			return
		}
		t205JSON(w, events)
	})
	router.Get("/__t205/state", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if !control(w, r) {
			return
		}
		sid, pid := r.URL.Query().Get("student_id"), r.URL.Query().Get("path_id")
		f, ok := owned[sid]
		if !ok || pid != f.PathID {
			w.WriteHeader(404)
			return
		}
		path, e := journey.GetLearningPathByID(r.Context(), sid, pid)
		if e != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(500)
			return
		}
		contextValue, e := journey.GetLearningContext(r.Context(), sid)
		if e != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(500)
			return
		}
		var revisions, applications, receipts, intents, intentEvents, consumed int
		e = pool.QueryRow(r.Context(), `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_path_revision WHERE student_learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_hybrid_application WHERE learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_hybrid_application_receipt r JOIN student_hybrid_application a USING(consequence_id) WHERE a.learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_intent WHERE learning_path_id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_outbox WHERE student_id=$2 AND subject='student.planning-state.changed.v1' AND payload->'data'->>'trigger_kind'='LEARNING_INTENT'),(SELECT count(*) FROM student_learning_intent WHERE learning_path_id=$1 AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL)`, pid, sid).Scan(&revisions, &applications, &receipts, &intents, &intentEvents, &consumed)
		if e != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(500)
			return
		}
		digests := map[string]string{}
		for _, item := range path.Items {
			raw, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
				Content      json.RawMessage
				Requirements []domain.LessonRequirement
			}{item.LessonContent, item.FrozenRequirements})
			hash := sha256.Sum256(raw)
			digests[item.ID] = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
		}
		// Public path JSON omits private frozen content; only digests are exposed.
		var binding any
		if f.LearningActionID != "" {
			b, e := actions.GetPracticeLearningAction(r.Context(), sid, f.TaskInstanceID)
			if e != nil {
				w.WriteHeader(500)
				return
			}
			binding = b
		}
		snap, e := getter.Handle(r.Context(), sid, pid, domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{Targets: f.Targets, TriggerContext: domain.PlanningSnapshotTrigger{Kind: "OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE", Reason: "actual_t205_readonly_probe"}})
		if e != nil {
			w.WriteHeader(500)
			return
		}
		t205JSON(w, map[string]any{"path": path, "context": contextValue, "revisions": revisions, "applications": applications, "receipts": receipts, "intents": intents, "intent_events": intentEvents, "consumed_intents": consumed, "private_digests": digests, "practice_binding": binding, "snapshot_refs": snap.References})
	})
	transport := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/internal/") {
			parts := strings.Split(r.URL.Path, "/")
			sid := ""
			for n, p := range parts {
				if p == "students" && n+1 < len(parts) {
					sid = parts[n+1]
					break
				}
			}
			if _, ok := owned[sid]; !ok {
				w.WriteHeader(404)
				return
			}
			authorizedPlanner := r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") == token
			apply, snapshot := strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/hybrid-consequences"), strings.HasSuffix(r.URL.Path, "/planning-snapshot")
			mu.Lock()
			unavailable := authorizedPlanner && ((apply && faults[sid]["APPLY_UNAVAILABLE"]) || (snapshot && faults[sid]["SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE"]))
			lose := authorizedPlanner && apply && faults[sid]["LOSE_NEXT_APPLY_RESPONSE"]
			if lose {
				faults[sid]["LOSE_NEXT_APPLY_RESPONSE"] = false
			}
			mu.Unlock()
			if unavailable {
				w.WriteHeader(503)
				return
			}
			if lose {
				rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
				router.ServeHTTP(rec, r)
				if rec.Code >= 200 && rec.Code < 300 {
					hijack, ok := w.(http.Hijacker)
					if !ok {
						http.Error(w, "loss injection unsupported", 500)
						return
					}
					conn, _, e := hijack.Hijack()
					if e == nil {
						_ = conn.Close()
					}
					return
				}
				for k, v := range rec.Header() {
					w.Header()[k] = v
				}
				w.WriteHeader(rec.Code)
				_, _ = w.Write(rec.Body.Bytes())
				return
			}
		}
		router.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
	server := httptest.NewServer(transport)
	defer server.Close()
	raw, e := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"url": server.URL, "planner_token": token, "practice_token": practiceToken, "teacher_token": teacherToken, "control_token": controlToken, "fixtures": fixtures})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	file, e := os.OpenFile(ready, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	_, e = file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if e != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("ready export failed")
	}
	t.Log("actual registered owner provider ready; named authored metadata and upstream Runtime projection/gateway fixture disclosed")
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal("SETUP: provider stop deadline reached")
		case <-ticker.C:
			if _, e := os.Lstat(stop); e == nil {
				return
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(e) {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
		}
	}
}
func t205JSON(w http.ResponseWriter, value any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(value)
}
func t205Decode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, value any) bool {
	reject := func() bool { w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest); return false }
	raw, e := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, 65537))
	if e != nil || len(raw) > 65536 {
		return reject()
	}
	shape := reflect.TypeOf(value)
	if shape == nil || shape.Kind() != reflect.Pointer || shape.Elem().Kind() != reflect.Struct {
		return reject()
	}
	shape = shape.Elem()
	required := map[string]bool{}
	for n := 0; n < shape.NumField(); n++ {
		key := shape.Field(n).Tag.Get("json")
		if key == "" || strings.Contains(key, ",") {
			return reject()
		}
		required[key] = false
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	open, e := decoder.Token()
	if e != nil || open != json.Delim('{') {
		return reject()
	}
	for decoder.More() {
		keyToken, e := decoder.Token()
		if e != nil {
			return reject()
		}
		key, ok := keyToken.(string)
		if !ok {
			return reject()
		}
		seen, known := required[key]
		if !known || seen {
			return reject()
		}
		var field json.RawMessage
		if decoder.Decode(&field) != nil || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(field), []byte("null")) {
			return reject()
		}
		required[key] = true
		if key == "student_id" {
			var sid string
			if json.Unmarshal(field, &sid) != nil || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(sid) {
				return reject()
			}
		}
	}
	close, e := decoder.Token()
	if e != nil || close != json.Delim('}') || decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return reject()
	}
	for _, present := range required {
		if !present {
			return reject()
		}
	}
	strict := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	strict.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if strict.Decode(value) != nil || strict.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return reject()
	}
	return true
}

// Named frozen Course execution metadata is admitted by the real lifecycle
// before ready export. FAILED ingress itself therefore never hides activation.
type t205OpenCourse struct {
	Answer domain.StudentTaskAnswer
	Action domain.StudentLearningAction
}

func t205OpenCourseFixture(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, f t205Fixture) t205OpenCourse {
	t.Helper()
	journey := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	path, e := journey.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, f.StudentID, f.PathID)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	item := path.Items[1]
	var req domain.LessonRequirement
	for _, candidate := range item.FrozenRequirements {
		if candidate.Type == "quiz_passed" && domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(candidate.SourceReference.ID) && domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(candidate.SourceReference.RevisionID) {
			req = candidate
			break
		}
	}
	if req.ID == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: named frozen Course execution requirement absent")
	}
	now := (t205OwnerClock{}).Now()
	frozen, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"id": req.SourceReference.ID, "_completion_fact_type": "quiz_passed", "_completion_source_revision_id": req.SourceReference.RevisionID})
	answer := domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: f.StudentID, TaskID: req.SourceReference.ID, LearningPathItemID: item.ID, RequirementID: req.ID, StartedAt: now, Status: domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now, AnswerPayload: json.RawMessage(`{}`), FrozenTaskJSON: frozen}
	action, e := domain.NewStudentLearningAction(domain.StudentLearningAction{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentTaskAnswerID: answer.ID, StudentID: f.StudentID, TaskID: answer.TaskID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLessonTask, ContextID: answer.TaskID, LearningTargets: item.Targets, EvidenceClass: domain.LearningEvidenceApplication, OpenedAt: now})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	answer, action, e = (postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}).CreateAnswer(ctx, answer, nil, action)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: real initial OPEN Course execution: %v", e)
	}
	return t205OpenCourse{Answer: answer, Action: action}
}

func t205InitialOwnerFixture(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, name string) t205Fixture {
	t.Helper()
	repo := &postgres.LearningJourneyRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	clock := t205OwnerClock{}
	now := clock.Now()
	sid := uuid.NewString()
	profile := domain.StudentOnboarding{StudentID: sid, DirectionCode: "backend", GoalCode: "go.backend", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}, KnownStacks: []string{}, SelfAssessedExperience: "basic", PreferredLanguage: "en", WeeklyMinutes: 60, PreferredPace: "standard", Version: 1, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	if _, e := (&postgres.StudentOnboardingRepoPG{Pool: pool}).Save(ctx, profile, 0); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	target := domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "t205." + strings.ReplaceAll(name, "_", ".") + ".a", Version: "v1"}
	templateTarget := target
	templateTarget.Key = "t205." + strings.ReplaceAll(name, "_", ".") + ".z"
	path := domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: sid, CourseID: uuid.NewString(), GoalCode: "go.backend", CourseFingerprint: "named-t205-frozen-course-" + name, PolicyVersion: domain.LearningPathPolicyVersion, PlannerPolicyVersion: "course-planner-v1", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, ReasonCode: "initial_plan", ReasonSummary: "Named initial authored owner fixture; no evidence injected", CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now}
	for n := 0; n < 4; n++ {
		item := domain.LearningPathItem{ID: uuid.NewString(), ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: uuid.NewString(), LessonRevisionID: uuid.NewString(), Position: n, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, ReasonCode: "current_gap", Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target}, LessonContent: json.RawMessage(fmt.Sprintf(`{"title":"Named T205 %s frozen lesson %d","private_marker":"%s"}`, name, n, uuid.NewString())), FrozenRequirements: []domain.LessonRequirement{{ID: uuid.NewString(), ActivityID: uuid.NewString(), Type: "theory_acknowledged", Required: true, SourceReference: domain.LessonSourceReference{ID: uuid.NewString()}}}}
		if n == 3 {
			item.Targets = []domain.LearningTargetRef{templateTarget}
		}
		if n == 0 {
			item.Status = domain.LearningPathItemReady
		}
		path.Items = append(path.Items, item)
	}
	if name == "no_change" {
		r := &path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[0]
		r.Type = "quiz_passed"
		r.SourceReference.RevisionID = uuid.NewString()
	}
	if name == "active_practice" {
		r := &path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[0]
		r.Type = "practice_completed"
		r.SourceReference.RevisionID = uuid.NewString()
		r.SourceReference.ID = r.SourceReference.RevisionID
	}
	var e error
	var replay bool
	path, replay, e = repo.CreateLearningPathIdempotently(ctx, path, repository.LearningPathCreationRequest{IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), RequestHash: strings.Repeat("a", 64)})
	if e != nil || replay {
		t.Fatalf("initial owner %s: %v", name, e)
	}
	if _, e = (studentuc.LessonCompletion{Repository: repo, Clock: clock}).AcknowledgeTheory(ctx, sid, path.Items[0].ID, path.Items[0].FrozenRequirements[0].ID, uuid.NewString()); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("real completed history %s: %v", name, e)
	}
	path, e = repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, sid, path.ID)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	desired := append([]domain.LearningPathItem{}, path.Items...)
	desired[0].Status = domain.LearningPathItemPlanned // owner reconciliation restores completed history exactly
	desired[1].Status = domain.LearningPathItemReady
	command := domain.LearningPathPlanningCommand{Schema: domain.LearningPathReplanRequestSchema, Kind: domain.LearningPathPlanningCommandReplan, StudentID: sid, LearningPathID: path.ID, PlanningRequestID: uuid.NewString(), IdempotencyKey: uuid.NewString(), CourseID: path.CourseID, GoalCode: path.GoalCode, CourseFingerprint: path.CourseFingerprint, PlannerPolicyVersion: path.PlannerPolicyVersion, ReasonCode: "current_gap", ReasonSummary: "Owner admission promotes next authored assignment after actual completed theory", ExpectedPathVersion: path.Version, DesiredItems: desired, RequestHash: strings.Repeat("b", 64), OccurredAt: clock.Now()}
	if _, _, e = repo.ApplyLearningPathPlanningCommand(ctx, command); e != nil {
		t.Fatalf("real next READY promotion %s: %v", name, e)
	}
	path, e = repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, sid, path.ID)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	f := t205Fixture{StudentID: sid, PathID: path.ID, Targets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{target, templateTarget}, Scope: domain.HybridScopeIdentity{GoalCode: "go.backend", DirectionCode: "backend", DesiredStacks: []string{"go"}}, CompletedItemID: path.Items[0].ID, ActiveItemID: path.Items[1].ID, PendingItemID: path.Items[2].ID, TemplateItemID: path.Items[3].ID, PathRevision: path.Version}
	if name == "active_practice" {
		r := path.Items[1].FrozenRequirements[0]
		f.RequirementID = r.ID
		f.TaskRevisionID = r.SourceReference.RevisionID
		f.TaskRevisionDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64)
		f.TaskInstanceID = uuid.NewString()
		uc := studentuc.PracticeLearningActions{Actions: postgres.LearningActionLifecycleRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Clock: clock, IDs: clock}
		binding, e := uc.Reserve(ctx, domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve{Schema: domain.StudentPracticeLearningActionReserveSchema, StudentID: sid, TaskInstanceID: f.TaskInstanceID, IdempotencyKey: f.TaskInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: f.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: f.TaskRevisionDigest, SurfaceClassification: "project", LearningTargets: path.Items[1].Targets, LearningPathID: f.PathID, LearningPathItemID: f.ActiveItemID, RequirementID: f.RequirementID})
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		binding, e = uc.Open(ctx, sid, f.TaskInstanceID, binding.LearningActionID)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		f.LearningActionID = binding.LearningActionID
		path, e = repo.GetLearningPathByID(ctx, sid, path.ID)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		f.PathRevision = path.Version
	}
	return f
}

// Hook admission regression: accepted false must be explicit, identities exact,
// and an oversized body cannot be truncated into an apparently valid request.
func TestT205ProofHookDecoder(t *testing.T) {
	sid := uuid.NewString()
	valid := fmt.Sprintf(`{"student_id":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":false}`, sid)
	cases := map[string]string{
		"duplicate":         fmt.Sprintf(`{"student_id":%q,"student_id":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":true}`, sid, sid),
		"case alias":        fmt.Sprintf(`{"Student_ID":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":true}`, sid),
		"null":              fmt.Sprintf(`{"student_id":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":null}`, sid),
		"missing enabled":   fmt.Sprintf(`{"student_id":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE"}`, sid),
		"missing identity":  `{"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":true}`,
		"type":              fmt.Sprintf(`{"student_id":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":"true"}`, sid),
		"unknown":           fmt.Sprintf(`{"student_id":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":true,"extra":1}`, sid),
		"multiple":          valid + ` {}`,
		"noncanonical uuid": fmt.Sprintf(`{"student_id":%q,"fault":"APPLY_UNAVAILABLE","enabled":true}`, strings.ToUpper(sid)),
		"oversize":          valid + strings.Repeat(" ", 65537),
	}
	for name, body := range cases {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var value struct {
				StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
				Fault     string `json:"fault"`
				Enabled   bool   `json:"enabled"`
			}
			w := httptest.NewRecorder()
			r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/__t205/control", strings.NewReader(body))
			if t205Decode(w, r, &value) || w.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
				t.Fatal("malformed proof hook command accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("explicit false", func(t *testing.T) {
		var value struct {
			StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
			Fault     string `json:"fault"`
			Enabled   bool   `json:"enabled"`
		}
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		if !t205Decode(w, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/__t205/control", strings.NewReader(valid)), &value) || value.StudentID != sid || value.Enabled {
			t.Fatal("valid explicit false rejected")
		}
	})
}
